Definition: from G3844 and the middle voice of G971; to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty):--constrain.
BiblicalUsage: Parabiazomai means to press, to constrain, to urge strongly. The two disciples constrain the risen Jesus, saying, Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and Lydia constrains Paul and his company, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and abide there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe holy pressing is a kind of hospitality: they would not let Jesus pass, and Lydia would not let Paul pass, and the evening became a blessing because they insisted.
